clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for bitumen mastic used as a surfacing material for bridge decks and roads.

clauses.title: Bitumen
clauses.text: 2.1 Bitumen — See Table 1 TABLE 1 PHYSICAL PROPERTIES OF BITUMEN SL. No. Characteristic Requirements (1) (2) (3) i) Softening point (ring and ball method) 50 to 90oC ii) Penetration at 25oC in 1/100 cm 10 to 40 iii) Ductility at 27oC, Min in cm 3 iv) Loss on heating, percent, Max 1 v) Solubility in carbon disulphide,percent Min  99

clauses.title: Filler
clauses.text: 2.2 Filler   The filler shall be lime stone powder passing 75-micron IS Sieve and shall have a calcium carbonate content of not less than 80 percent by weight.

clauses.title: Fine Aggregate – Fine
clauses.text: 2.3.1 Fine Aggregate - Fine aggregate shall consist of naturally occuring sand or crushed lime stone or crushed hard-rock. The grading of the fine aggregates inclusive of the filler is given in Table 2 for guidance. TABLE 2 GRADING OF FINE AGGREGATES S.l No. Passing Retained on Percentage by IS  Sieve IS  Sieve mass Min Max (1) (2) (3) (4) (5) i) 75 - micron — 0 5 ii) 212 - micron 75 micron 10 20 iii) 600 - micron 212 micron 5 35 iv)       2.36 mm 600 micron 0 25

clauses.title: Coarse Aggregate
clauses.text: 2.3.2 Coarse Aggregate  — Coarse aggregate shall consist of hard durable crushed rock having aggregate impact value of not more than 20 and abrasion value not more than 40.

clauses.title: Hardness Number
clauses.text: 3. Hardness Number  —  The bitumen mastic whose composition is given at Table 3 before the addition of coarse aggregate, shall have hardness number of 60 to 80 at 25°C.
